title: EVEscape: predicting viral variants before they emerge
summary: Starting from January 2020, the tool predicted SARS-CoV-2 mutations with accuracy similar to experimental antibody-binding assays and ranked their prevalence better; it generalizes to HIV and influenza. Retrospective validation; prospective performance is not reported.
organization: Harvard Medical School and University of Oxford

evidence.tested: EVEscape was trained only on pre-2020 sequences and compared against high-throughput experimental scans of SARS-CoV-2 variation that later emerged, a retrospective validation; prospective performance is not reported.
evidence.unknown: The abstract states no limitations; the page says testing on Lassa and Nipah is ongoing and vaccine or therapy use against future variants is a future application.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning model of historical viral sequences, combined with biophysical and structural information, scored the escape potential of mutations.
